system.specialAbility: Rage ❶: Temporary Vigor equal to your level + Might, +2 melee damage, −1 Evade, and you are Heedless while it lasts. The damage rises to +4 at Expert, +6 at Master, +8 at Legendary.
system.description: Grants Training in Athletics, and 4 Vigor per level. Only your first Calling counts toward Vigor, however many you open later.
